segments.normalizedSource: ```swift override func prepareForDisplay() { super.prepareForDisplay() if let cluster = annotation as? MKClusterAnnotation { let totalBikes = cluster.memberAnnotations.count if count(cycleType: .unicycle) > 0 { image = drawUnicycleCount(count: totalBikes) } else { let tricycleCount = count(cycleType: .tricycle) image = drawRatioBicycleToTricycle(tricycleCount, to: totalBikes) } if count(cycleType: .unicycle) > 0 { displayPriority = .defaultLow } else { displayPriority = .defaultHigh } } } ```
